name: green-level-right-pad-no-clamp
note: G1 design §8, FROZEN: termination is authoritative and right_pad never clamps it. Spawn s=0 with right_pad=3 gives a provisional x2 of s+3=3, but close[1]=20 > L=10 terminates at bar 1, so x2bar=1 -- strictly LESS than s+right_pad. §8 says this already holds for all six until predicates and is merely unreachable in practice; this pins it on an implemented mode so it cannot drift.
